Fishbuddy (by fiskher) is everything you could want from a fishing app.
First and foremost, you'll find information about what you can fish, where and how.
In Fishbuddy, we've let some of the very best fishermen find and share the best fishing spots in their own country, both in sea and freshwater.
The app also gives you razor-sharp satellite images and handy depth maps.
Fishbuddy is the world's first fishing app that combines Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Augmented Reality (AR), allowing you to seamlessly record catches in the app's logbook. By taking a photo of the fish, you can save information about species, length and weight, as well as location and weather information, with a single tap. If you want to show off your catch to others, share all or part of the information in the feed. You can also keep track of your own rankings and participate in or organise internal fishing competitions.
Fishbuddy is the fishing guide you can take with you in your pocket.
Some of the app's features:
Fishbuddy fishing areas
110,000+ manually registered fishing spots for sea and freshwater
Created and verified by hand-picked fishing experts in each country
Our fishing grounds are displayed as coloured areas for each species, making it easier to understand the fishing spot
The app shows 15-25 popular fish species in each country. All with unique colours, useful species information and with smart filtering options
Fishbuddy registration and measurement tool
Using advanced camera technology and our own team of AR and AI developers, we've created the world's best fish recognition feature. By including AR, we can accurately measure length and provide an estimate of weight. This gives you quick and easy information, and if you share it with us, it will contribute to the management of SDG 14: Life below water.
The world's first AR-powered competition tool
Fishbuddy Competition Tool is the world's first self-powered competition tool. Here, everyone can compete against each other and see who is the best fisherman. The app acts as a judge, organiser and displays an interactive leaderboard. 2 or 2 million fishermen? No problem. And it's all free.
Always a competition!
With Fishbuddy, you'll automatically be able to create and participate in a range of informal competitions and climb the leaderboards. Who has caught the biggest cod in the family, or how many species have you caught this summer? Who has the best fishing luck at work?
